Below is the Read code list for myocardial infarction (MI). I built it from term searches for "myocardial infarction", "infarct" and "coronary thrombosis", plus code searches for G30 and G31. I did not run separate searches for "heart attack", "STEMI" or "NSTEMI". The G30 code search returned "Heart attack", and the other terms appeared in the MI results.

I've split it into two parts. Part A holds codes for an acute or recent MI. Part B holds codes for an old or past MI. Part B is optional. Include it if "currently has" should cover a past MI as a lifelong diagnosis, which is common practice. Leave it out if you only want acute or recent events.

Below is the Read code list for myocardial infarction (MI). I built it from term searches for "myocardial infarction", "infarct" and "coronary thrombosis", plus code searches for G30 and G31. I did not run separate searches for "heart attack", "STEMI" or "NSTEMI". The G30 code search returned "Heart attack", and the other terms appeared in the MI results.

I've split it into two parts. Part A holds codes for an acute or recent MI. Part B holds codes for an old or past MI. Part B is optional. Include it if "currently has" should cover a past MI as a lifelong diagnosis, which is common practice. Leave it out if you only want acute or recent events.
